coverageScope: Enumerated checked-in executable source and migration columns; not deployed configuration, binary artifacts, dependency transitives or upstream schema 0.2 conformance.

profileDecisions.rationale: Intentionally public campaign content; transport/provider encryption is not private E2EE
Explicit business/identity/restricted-distribution processing; service/provider may access plaintext and no E2EE claim is made
On-device planning/downloads; user and browser publisher are trusted, no message protocol claimed

Ratcheted MLS, root/device lifecycle and client vault source/tests are installed. Runtime still rejects activation pending the pinned executable web-release/update, independently witnessed transparency and transport controls. Owner AI review does not waive endpoint/protocol controls.
requiredEvidence: exact applicable protocol/profile and upstream remediation pins
authenticated recipient/device authority and host/endpoint obligations
interoperability, adversarial and negative no-fallback tests
source/build/configuration/runtime bound AI security review; independent expert/certification status separately tracked

storage.classification: Opaque signed authority to one original recorded checkout; no identity or card data
storage.authority: Original checkout browser only, HttpOnly Secure SameSite cookie; HMAC, exact ledger/provider identity/mode/amount binding and separate short-lived POST CSRF; Stripe email login remains processor-owned
storage.retention: 30 days; only latest checkout capability in browser; explicit forget action expires cookie
storage.disposal: Expire browser cookie; no volunteer identity or card storage, no restoration by guessed checkout URL

storage.classification: Sensitive private identity/MLS state, transient plaintext and locally encrypted vault envelopes; no hosted access
storage.authority: Unexposed component caller; intended authorized recipient endpoint only after signed device state and independent root verification. No directory/identity login grants decryption.
storage.retention: Component objects only; no persistent browser/network adapter is installed. Lock helpers erase mutable master/epoch buffers where practical; caller lifetime and remaining JavaScript copies are outside a perfect erasure claim.
storage.disposal: Retire old epoch keys and drop historical receiver state. Selected backup-none policy prohibits private-key/history recovery exports; browser persistence, atomic locking/invalidation and no-recovery acknowledgement still require integration before activation.

storage.retention: Public proof/key nonreuse histories retained for historical signature validation; single-use package hashes never recycled; public package wire expires; abandoned claims remain tombstones
storage.disposal: Expire public package wire and withdraw routing; no invented signed revocation, no account-only restoration of private thread keys
